release_notes: Adds a first-class Proforma Invoice workspace with independent PI numbering, history, templates, defaults, export location, revisions, archive/restore and recovery behavior.
Final Proforma Invoice exports are now single-copy documents with no Customer Copy or Office Copy labels; Tax Invoice retains its existing two-copy behavior.
Adds side-effect-free Quotation Preview for consistent document review across Quotation, Proforma Invoice and Tax Invoice.
Widens the Quotation Description column consistently across PDF, Word and Excel exports.
Adds stable History sorting by ID number, document number, date, customer, status, total amount and last modified, with ascending/descending control and ID-descending as the stable default.
Fixes Draft deletion eligibility so Draft records can be deleted correctly while non-Draft lifecycle records remain protected.
Preserves separated Quotation, Proforma and Tax Invoice concrete domains with neutral shared financial and History infrastructure.
Uses database schema 10. Existing schema-8 installations upgrade through the validated schema 9 to 10 migrations; existing schema-10 Stage 2 R1 data remains compatible.
Preserves the existing installer AppId, update backup validation, installer checksum/size validation and verified rollback protections.
